comparison.objective: Extract a retaining pin while supporting a weighted carriage; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR coordinates load support and fastener extraction to prevent a drop. Candidate uses a recessed hex tool and adjustment collar, then operates an impact fixture.
comparison.success_condition: PR reports safe pin extraction and retained carriage height, but its available body omits exact scoring thresholds. Candidate requires two explicit energy-, velocity-, travel-, force-, rebound-, and drift-bounded stops.
comparison.reason: Load-bearing support transfer during extraction is materially different from fine adjustment and repeated damping validation.
